changelog: Android 16 support: the app now targets API 36 and respects the status and navigation bars on Android 15/16, with the composer staying above the keyboard. Status bar and navigation icons stay light even when the phone is in light mode. Chat notifications use a messaging foreground service, so Android 15's six-hour data-sync limit no longer stops them. Removed the unused USB-camera native libraries: the download is about 5 MB instead of 13 MB, and the APK is 16 KB page-size compatible. Live broadcasts now use RTMPS (encrypted RTMP) when the server provides it.
